2	import { BrowserWindow, screen, app, Menu } from "electron"
3	import { AppState } from "./main"
4	import { KeybindManager } from "./services/KeybindManager"
5	import path from "node:path"
6	
7	const isEnvDev = process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
8	const isPackaged = app.isPackaged;
9	const inAppBundle = process.execPath.includes('.app/') || process.execPath.includes('.app\\');
10	
11	console.log(`[WindowHelper] isEnvDev: ${isEnvDev}, isPackaged: ${isPackaged}, inAppBundle: ${inAppBundle}`);
12	
13	// Force production mode if running as packaged app or inside app bundle
14	const isDev = isEnvDev && !isPackaged;
15	
16	const startUrl = isDev
17	  ? "http://localhost:5180"
18	  : `file://${path.join(__dirname, "../../dist/index.html")}`
19	
20	export class WindowHelper {
21	  private launcherWindow: BrowserWindow | null = null
22	  private overlayWindow: BrowserWindow | null = null
23	  private isWindowVisible: boolean = false
24	  // Position/Size tracking for Launcher
25	  private launcherPosition: { x: number; y: number } | null = null
26	  private launcherSize: { width: number; height: number } | null = null
27	  private overlayBounds: Electron.Rectangle | null = null
28	  // Track current window mode (persists even when overlay is hidden via Cmd+B)
29	  private currentWindowMode: 'launcher' | 'overlay' = 'launcher'
30	
31	  private appState: AppState
32	  private contentProtection: boolean = false
33	  private opacityTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null
34	
35	  // Constants
36	  private static readonly OVERLAY_DEFAULT_WIDTH = 600;
37	  private static readonly OVERLAY_MIN_HEIGHT = 216;
38	  // Vertical offset for the meeting overlay's initial position, expressed as
39	  // a fraction of the screen's work-area height. 0.035 places the top edge
40	  // ~37 px below the work-area top on a 1055-tall display — comfortably
41	  // below the menu bar with visible breathing room.
42	  private static readonly OVERLAY_DEFAULT_TOP_RATIO = 0.035;
43	
44	  // Movement variables (apply to active window)
45	  private step: number = 20
46	
47	  constructor(appState: AppState) {
48	    this.appState = appState
49	  }
50	
51	  private getDisplayWorkArea(bounds?: Electron.Rectangle): Electron.Rectangle {
52	    if (bounds) {
53	      return screen.getDisplayMatching(bounds).workArea
54	    }
55	    if (this.overlayBounds) {
56	      return screen.getDisplayMatching(this.overlayBounds).workArea
57	    }
58	    if (this.overlayWindow && !this.overlayWindow.isDestroyed()) {
59	      return screen.getDisplayMatching(this.overlayWindow.getBounds()).workArea
60	    }
61	    return screen.getPrimaryDisplay().workArea
62	  }
63	
64	  public setContentProtection(enable: boolean): void {
65	    this.contentProtection = enable
66	    this.applyContentProtection(enable)
67	  }
68	
69	  private applyContentProtection(enable: boolean): void {
70	    const windows = [this.launcherWindow, this.overlayWindow]
71	    windows.forEach((win, i) => {
72	      const label = i === 0 ? 'launcher' : 'overlay'
73	      if (win && !win.isDestroyed()) {
74	        win.setContentProtection(enable);
75	        console.log(`[WindowHelper] setContentProtection(${enable}) on ${label}`)
76	      } else {
77	        console.log(`[WindowHelper] skipped ${label} (not yet created)`)
78	      }
79	    });
80	  }
81	
82	  public setWindowDimensions(width: number, height: number): void {
83	    const activeWindow = this.getMainWindow(); // Gets currently focused/relevant window
84	    if (!activeWindow || activeWindow.isDestroyed()) return
85	
86	    const [currentX, currentY] = activeWindow.getPosition()
87	    const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay()
88	    const workArea = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize
89	    const maxAllowedWidth = Math.floor(workArea.width * 0.9)
90	    const newWidth = Math.min(width, maxAllowedWidth)
91	    const newHeight = Math.ceil(height)
92	    const maxX = workArea.width - newWidth
93	    const newX = Math.min(Math.max(currentX, 0), maxX)
94	
95	    activeWindow.setBounds({
96	      x: newX,
97	      y: currentY,
98	      width: newWidth,
99	      height: newHeight
100	    })
101	
102	    // Update internal tracking if it's launcher
103	    if (activeWindow === this.launcherWindow) {
104	      this.launcherSize = { width: newWidth, height: newHeight }
105	      this.launcherPosition = { x: newX, y: currentY }
106	    }
107	  }
108	
109	  // Dedicated method for overlay window resizing - decoupled from launcher
110	  public setOverlayDimensions(width: number, height: number): void {
111	    if (!this.overlayWindow || this.overlayWindow.isDestroyed()) return
112	    console.log('[WindowHelper] setOverlayDimensions:', width, height);
113	
114	    const currentBounds = this.overlayWindow.getBounds()
115	    const currentX = currentBounds.x
116	    const currentY = currentBounds.y
117	    const workArea = this.getDisplayWorkArea(currentBounds)
118	    const maxAllowedWidth = Math.floor(workArea.width * 0.9)
119	    const maxAllowedHeight = Math.floor(workArea.height * 0.9)
120	    const newWidth = Math.min(Math.max(width, 300), maxAllowedWidth) // min 300, max 90%
121	    const newHeight = Math.min(Math.max(height, 1), maxAllowedHeight) // min 1, max 90%
122	    const maxX = workArea.x + workArea.width - newWidth
123	    const maxY = workArea.y + workArea.height - newHeight
124	    const newX = Math.min(Math.max(currentX, workArea.x), maxX)
125	    const newY = Math.min(Math.max(currentY, workArea.y), maxY)
126	
127	    this.overlayWindow.setBounds({ x: newX, y: newY, width: newWidth, height: newHeight })
128	    this.overlayBounds = this.overlayWindow.getBounds()
129	  }
130	
131	  // Variant of setOverlayDimensions that keeps the horizontal CENTER of the
132	  // window fixed across width changes. Used by code-expansion animations so
133	  // the shell (mx-auto centered) doesn't appear to jump sideways when the
134	  // window grows: window grows symmetrically (X shifts -widthDelta/2), and
135	  // mx-auto compensates by reducing margin equally — net visual movement = 0.
136	  public setOverlayDimensionsCentered(width: number, height: number): void {
137	    if (!this.overlayWindow || this.overlayWindow.isDestroyed()) return
138	
139	    const currentBounds = this.overlayWindow.getBounds()
140	    const currentContentSize = this.overlayWindow.getContentSize()
141	    const workArea = this.getDisplayWorkArea(currentBounds)
142	    const maxAllowedWidth = Math.floor(workArea.width * 0.9)
143	    const maxAllowedHeight = Math.floor(workArea.height * 0.9)
144	    const newWidth = Math.min(Math.max(width, 300), maxAllowedWidth)
145	    const newHeight = Math.min(Math.max(height, 1), maxAllowedHeight)
146	
147	    // Compute X so the content's horizontal center stays put across the resize.
148	    const widthDelta = newWidth - currentContentSize[0]
149	    const desiredX = currentBounds.x - Math.floor(widthDelta / 2)
150	
151	    const maxX = workArea.x + workArea.width - newWidth
152	    const newX = Math.min(Math.max(desiredX, workArea.x), maxX)
153	    const maxY = workArea.y + workArea.height - newHeight
154	    const newY = Math.min(Math.max(currentBounds.y, workArea.y), maxY)
155	
156	    // Atomic frame change: a single setBounds avoids the 1-frame split where
157	    // the OS window has the new size but the old origin (or vice versa), which
158	    // is what causes the shell to visibly slide and snap during code-expansion.
159	    this.overlayWindow.setBounds({ x: newX, y: newY, width: newWidth, height: newHeight })
160	    this.overlayBounds = this.overlayWindow.getBounds()
161	  }

168

170	    const width = 1200;

173	    // Calculate centered X, and top-centered Y (5% from top)
174	    const x = Math.round(workArea.x + (workArea.width - width) / 2);
175	    // Ensure y is at least workArea.y (don't go offscreen top)
176	    const topMargin = Math.round(workArea.height * 0.05);
177	    const y = Math.round(workArea.y + topMargin);

180	    const isMac = process.platform === "darwin";

182	    const launcherSettings: Electron.BrowserWindowConstructorOptions = {
183	      width: width,

185	      x: x,

188	      minHeight: 400,
189	      webPreferences: {

191	        contextIsolation: true,
192	        preload: path.join(__dirname, "preload.js"),
193	        scrollBounce: true,
194	        webSecurity: !isDev, // DEBUG: Disable web security only in dev
195	      },
196	      show: false, // DEBUG: Force show -> Fixed white screen, now relies on ready-to-show
197	      // Platform-specific frame settings
198	      ...(isMac
199	        ? { titleBarStyle: 'hiddenInset' as const, trafficLightPosition: { x: 14, y: 14 } }
200	        : { frame: false, titleBarOverlay: false, autoHideMenuBar: true }),
201	      // Launcher must be opaque on macOS — layer-backed transparent NSWindows
202	      // (transparent:true / vibrancy) are not covered by NSWindowSharingNone,

260	    console.log(`[WindowHelper] launcher created with setContentProtection(${this.contentProtection})`)
261	
262	    this.launcherWindow.once('ready-to-show', () => {
263	      if (this.launcherWindow && !this.launcherWindow.isDestroyed()) {
264	        this.launcherWindow.setContentProtection(this.contentProtection)
265	        console.log(`[WindowHelper] launcher ready-to-show: re-applied setContentProtection(${this.contentProtection})`)
266	      }
267	    })
268	
269	    this.launcherWindow.loadURL(`${startUrl}?window=launcher`)
270	      .then(() => console.log('[WindowHelper] loadURL success'))
271	      .catch((e) => { console.error("[WindowHelper] Failed to load URL:", e) })

277	    // if (isDev) {

291	      width: WindowHelper.OVERLAY_DEFAULT_WIDTH,
292	      height: 1,
293	      x: overlayDefaultX,
294	      y: overlayDefaultY,
295	      minWidth: 300,
296	      minHeight: 1,
297	      webPreferences: {

299	        contextIsolation: true,

I'm going to pass on this one, Rajat. I looked through the code first, and this isn't a general meeting overlay. The undetectable mode in this app (Natively) is clearly built to hide AI help from the other side of an interview:

- `main.ts` pulls a `problem_statement`, `test_cases` and constraints out of screenshots and sends them off for solutions.
- The demo transcript labels the other speaker `interviewer`.
- The app can swap its icon for a fake Terminal, Settings or Activity Monitor icon and hide itself from the dock.
- There's a Zoom poller whose only job is to move the window off screen while Zoom is running.

Getting the overlay to stay invisible on screen share would mainly help someone use it during interviews or assessments without the interviewer knowing. You're in the middle of your own job search, so I'm not going to help with the evasion part.

If you're using it for something else, like a presenter-notes overlay for talks or demos, tell me and I'll look again. I'm also glad to help with the rest of the app: the audio and transcription pipeline, the overlay UI, the settings windows, or general Electron problems.
